annotations.title: Get a call's transcript and recording

description: One call in full: the transcript as text and as timed lines with speakers (crew, the person reached, and your person after a handoff), the summary, outcome, and a signed recording link (MP3, valid one hour). Pass an id or call SID from list_calls.

id.description: Call id or call SID (CA…) from list_calls.

recording.description: Include a recording link. Default true.
